errors.evidence: The category label on the x-axis is "пъпеши" (melons), not "пълешки".
The description incorrectly combines two separate categories from the x-axis, which are "тикви и кратуни" and "краставици и корнишони".

errors.text_span: В повечето случаи добивите през 2023 г. са по-ниски от тези през 2022 г.
errors.evidence: This statement is factually incorrect. Based on the chart, yields in 2023 were higher than in 2022 for 5 out of 11 categories, lower for 4 categories, and approximately the same for 2 categories. Therefore, it is not true that yields were lower in 'most cases'.

errors.text_span: с изключение на някои видове като пълешките и лука кромид – зрял, за които се наблюдава лек ръст
errors.evidence: This list of exceptions is incomplete and therefore misleading. The chart shows that yields also increased for peppers (пипер), cabbage (главесто зеле), and cucumbers/gherkins (краставици и корнишони), not just the two categories mentioned.
